```python
def paginate(items: list, page: int, per_page: int) -> dict:
    total = len(items)
    total_pages = (total + per_page - 1) // per_page if per_page > 0 else 0
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    end = start + per_page
    page_items = items[start:end] if start >= 0 else []
    return {'items': page_items, 'page': page, 'total_pages': total_pages}
```
Note: assumed valid page>=1/per_page>0 inputs (no explicit validation); total_pages=0 for empty list; beyond-last-page yields [].
